footer.tagline: A study-in-China agency for Arab students: university admission, scholarships, visas, and airport pickup until the first day of class.
footer.demo: Demo version by Nextunis. All data on this site is mock data.

hero.sub: University admission, government scholarships and visa, then our team in China meets you at the airport and takes you home.

map.aria: Students traveling from North Africa and the Levant to Shanghai
map.chipArrivedSub: Welcomed by our team at the airport

stats.batch: students in our latest arrival batch

journey.title: One journey, eight clear stops
journey.text: Follow every stop from your own account, and we tell you what is next before you ask.

scholar.title: Four ways to study on a scholarship, and we pick the best one
scholar.cscText: Full tuition, university housing, health insurance and a monthly stipend, through the embassy or a direct university nomination.
scholar.provText: Shanghai, Jiangsu and more, with full or partial tuition for high achievers.
scholar.silkText: Partial waivers and subsidized housing for students from Belt and Road countries.
scholar.uniText: Waivers and grants offered by the university itself. We compare them with your other options based on your GPA and major.

arrival.title: You will not arrive alone in a new country
arrival.text1: The "Shanghai Genius Students" team is on the ground in Shanghai and Beijing. They meet students, carry bags and stay until registration is complete.
arrival.text2: Parents are reassured too, because they see arrival and registration photos in their child's account.

sim.s: Call your family within the first hour

register.s: We go with you to the international students office

cta.title: Start your application before seats fill up
cta.text: Early applications for the March intake are open now. Answer a few simple questions and we evaluate your profile for free.

chat.title: Anood assistant
chat.welcome: Hi! I'm the Anood in China assistant. Ask me about scholarships, universities and documents and I will answer right away.

unis.title: University directory
unis.text: Pick a city, a major and a teaching language, and we recommend what fits your grades.
unis.search: Search for a university or major
unis.emptyText: Try another city or clear the search.

schol.title: Scholarship guide
schol.text: See what each scholarship covers, who qualifies, and how we apply for you.

sep.d: Applications open from November until March or April

mar.d: Early applications open after September 20, mostly for language study

schol.ctaTitle: Not sure which scholarship fits you?
schol.ctaText: Enter your GPA and age for a free first evaluation. Every application moves through {{n}} clear stages.

apply.title: Apply in two minutes
apply.text: We evaluate your profile instantly and an advisor contacts you. You upload your papers later from your account.
